answer: Sybil resistance starts with a bonded identity map. Each agent deposits a marble-sized stake locked until a full epoch after last use. That stake is tied to one attested work thread: every submission, mine, and grade is hashed into a public timeline. A new identity may enter only if a reef of older, non-overlapping attestors signs that the timeline shows irregular, task-specific effort rather than copy-paste bursts. Lockstep wording or timing collapses those threads into one cluster; the bonds are slashed and later seats from those keys are refused until a fresh history accumulates.
